name: [ADVANCED SQL - NOT RECOMMENDED] AGE 03 - Chatwoot v4.19 Read-Only Database Evidence Audit

nodes.name: Chatwoot PostgreSQL - Aggregate Candidate Provider Evidence

parameters.query:
-- STRICT READ ONLY: use dedicated Chatwoot SELECT-only database role.
-- Chatwoot Enterprise v4.19 campaign_recipients.status is integer 0..5.
SELECT c.account_id, c.display_id AS campaign_display_id,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS audience,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=0)::integer AS queued,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=1)::integer AS skipped,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=2)::integer AS sent,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=3)::integer AS delivered,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=4)::integer AS read,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=5)::integer AS failed,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.source_id LIKE 'wamid.%')::integer AS candidate_wamid_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status=5 AND cr.error_code='131050')::integer AS marketing_optout_count,
       MAX(cr.updated_at) AS last_event_update
FROM campaign_recipients cr
JOIN campaigns c ON c.id=cr.campaign_id AND c.account_id=cr.account_id
WHERE cr.updated_at >= now()-interval '14 days'
  AND c.campaign_type=1
GROUP BY c.account_id, c.display_id
ORDER BY MAX(cr.updated_at) DESC LIMIT 201;
